items.difficulty_reason: 44 行、三步：①对复形宽度 b-a 归约，用三角 + K-flat 的 two-out-of-three（More on Algebra）降到单项层情形；②Čech 复形与交错 Čech 复形同伦等价（Cohomology）；③有限交仿射 ⇒ 截面是 A-平坦，交错 Čech 是有界平坦复形 ⇒ K-flat。承重的归纳与两项替换都在 span 内；3 处跨章引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-K-flat (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5897-5912

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the induction on the width of the bounded complex through the distinguished triangle and the two-out-of-three property of K-flatness, the replacement of the Cech complex by the alternating Cech complex up to homotopy, and the K-flatness of a bounded complex of flat modules obtained from the affinity of the intersections (source lines 5914-5940)
